hunks.baseline: Inside the office, every source of light had been blocked out. When a holographic video began playing in the darkness, I was suddenly overcome by the sensation that I was there at the scene myself.
hunks.sol: Every source of light in the office had been blocked out. As the holographic video began playing in the darkness, I suddenly felt as though I were standing at the scene myself.

hunks.baseline: Everything was gray. I couldn’t see even an inch ahead of me.
hunks.sol: Everything was gray. I couldn’t see an inch in front of me.

hunks.baseline: Only after I saw the massive wings of an eagle skim past dangerously close did I realize where the video had begun.
hunks.sol: Only after an eagle’s massive wing swept dangerously close did I realize where the footage had begun.

hunks.baseline: The drone capturing the entire scene descended rapidly to avoid the fine dust filling the atmosphere.
hunks.sol: The drone recording the scene descended rapidly, escaping the fine dust that filled the air.

hunks.baseline: After descending through the fierce wind for some time, what finally emerged was a city engulfed in flames.
hunks.sol: After plunging through the fierce wind for some time, it finally emerged above a city engulfed in flames.

hunks.baseline: The factories belching smoke exploded one after another. Massive buildings collapsed like dominoes, while people who looked like tiny dots screamed and fled in every direction.
hunks.sol: Factories belching smoke exploded one after another. Towering buildings toppled like dominoes, while people who looked like tiny dots screamed and fled in every direction.

hunks.baseline: It was pandemonium.
hunks.sol: Pandemonium.

hunks.baseline: There were too many people to count individually.
hunks.sol: There were too many of them to count.

hunks.baseline: Thousands were visible at a glance. If the people the camera had failed to capture were included, there had to be tens of thousands.
hunks.sol: Thousands were visible at a glance. Including those beyond the camera’s view, there had to be tens of thousands.

hunks.baseline: A lament escaped me before I could stop it. Was this because of a factory explosion?
hunks.sol: A groan escaped me before I could stop it. Was this because of some factory explosion?

hunks.baseline: No. It was because I had discovered creatures racing through the maze-like city, wreaking destruction and slaughter.
hunks.sol: No. It was because I had spotted creatures racing through the maze-like city, spreading destruction and slaughter wherever they went.

hunks.baseline: Their eyes gleamed with killing intent as they swept across their surroundings. Then, with a series of hideous roars, they began moving in search of targets.
hunks.sol: Their eyes gleamed with killing intent as they swept across their surroundings. Then, letting out hideous roars, they began searching for targets.

hunks.baseline: *Why are there monsters there?*
hunks.sol: *Why are there monsters out there?*

hunks.baseline: The question lasted only a moment before I realized the answer myself.
hunks.sol: The question lasted only a moment before the answer came to me.

hunks.baseline: There was only one possibility in a situation like this.
hunks.sol: There was only one possibility.

hunks.baseline: *Monster Wave.*
hunks.sol: *A Monster Wave.*

hunks.baseline: But after the Demon King Asmodeus disappeared, the monsters’ power weakened, and Gates became doors that only humans could freely pass through.
hunks.sol: But after the Demon King Asmodeus was destroyed, the monsters’ power weakened, and Gates became doors that only humans could pass through freely.

hunks.baseline: That was a Monster Wave, and the result was the scene the holographic video was showing us now.
hunks.sol: That was a Monster Wave, and the holographic video was showing us the result.

hunks.baseline: Squish!
hunks.sol: Crunch!

hunks.baseline: The zoomed-in camera showed the urban center where a massacre was taking place.
hunks.sol: The camera zoomed in on the massacre unfolding in the heart of the city.

hunks.baseline: Some were impaled on monster claws. Others were trampled to death beneath the feet of the fleeing crowd.
hunks.sol: Some were impaled on monsters’ claws. Others were trampled to death beneath the feet of the fleeing crowd.

hunks.baseline: Amid that pit of chaos, a mother and daughter running for their lives caught my eye.
hunks.sol: Amid that maelstrom of chaos, a mother and daughter running for their lives caught my eye.

hunks.baseline: That was when the woman shouted urgently.
hunks.sol: The woman had barely shouted the words when—

hunks.baseline: A spear flew from a dark alley, pierced the woman through the chest, and embedded itself in the ground.
hunks.sol: A spear flew from a dark alley, pierced her chest, and buried itself in the ground.

hunks.baseline: She vomited up a mouthful of blood, then her body went limp.
hunks.sol: She coughed up a gush of blood and went limp.

hunks.baseline: The child, who had witnessed her mother’s death right before her eyes, burst into tears.
hunks.sol: The child burst into tears at the sight of her mother dying before her eyes.

hunks.baseline: But it wasn’t over yet. More than a hundred Orcs poured out of the dark alley and advanced toward the child.
hunks.sol: But it wasn’t over yet. More than a hundred Orcs poured from the dark alley and advanced on the child.

hunks.baseline: They had taken up ideal positions to block the fleeing civilians’ escape routes.
hunks.sol: The alley was perfectly positioned to cut off the fleeing civilians’ escape route.

hunks.baseline: The leader stared down at his arm with bewilderment.
hunks.sol: The leader stared down at its arm in confusion.

hunks.baseline: The thick arm that had been holding the axe had been cleanly severed below the elbow. A man was standing before him now, though the Orc hadn’t noticed him arrive.
hunks.sol: The thick arm holding the axe had been cleanly severed below the elbow. Before the Orc stood a man who hadn’t been there a moment ago.

hunks.baseline: “How dare you monsters lay hands on the people of China?”
hunks.sol: “How dare mere monsters lay hands on the people of China?”

hunks.baseline: The answer rang out loudly.
hunks.sol: The answer rang out.

hunks.baseline: The man was not alone. Even now, Hunters belonging to the Public Security Armed Forces, their armor emblazoned with China’s Five-Starred Red Flag, were steadily joining the battlefield.
hunks.sol: The man was not alone. Hunters from the Public Security Armed Forces, their armor emblazoned with China’s Five-Starred Red Flag, were streaming onto the battlefield even now.

hunks.baseline: The man shouted, his eyes burning.
hunks.sol: The man shouted, his eyes blazing.

hunks.baseline: With a tremendous roar, more than a thousand Hunters charged forward.
hunks.sol: With a tremendous roar, nearly a thousand Hunters charged forward.

hunks.baseline: China still had a population of well over a billion despite suffering enormous losses during the Great Cataclysm.
hunks.sol: Despite the enormous losses it had suffered during the Great Cataclysm, China still had a population of well over a billion.

hunks.baseline: The monsters rampaging through the city had no intention of simply standing by and watching. When every kind of monster gathered in one place, their numbers easily surpassed a thousand as well.
hunks.sol: The monsters rampaging through the city weren’t about to stand by and watch. Every kind of monster converged in one place, their numbers easily surpassing a thousand as well.

hunks.baseline: Two waves that could never coexist rushed toward each other.
hunks.sol: Two waves that could never coexist surged toward each other.

hunks.baseline: Eyes shining with resolve, and killing intent directed at the enemy.
hunks.sol: Eyes shone with grim resolve and the desire to kill.

hunks.baseline: The incredible force of the scene filled the office, so intense that it was hard to believe we were watching a holographic video.
hunks.sol: The force of the scene filled the office, so overwhelming that it was hard to believe we were watching a holographic video.

hunks.baseline: The drone captured the two groups rapidly closing the distance between them from high above.
hunks.sol: High above, the drone captured the two forces rapidly closing the distance between them.

hunks.baseline: “Perish in the flames of the inferno. Fire Rain.”
hunks.sol: “Perish in hellfire. Fire Rain.”

hunks.baseline: A cold, lifeless voice.
hunks.sol: A cold voice utterly devoid of life.

hunks.baseline: It was a sight I had never seen before.
hunks.sol: It was a sight unlike anything I had ever seen.

hunks.baseline: About thirty meters above the ground, not far from the drone, the air peeled open as though something had sliced through it.
hunks.sol: About thirty meters in the air, not far from the drone, the empty space peeled open as though something had sliced through it.

hunks.baseline: The Chinese Hunters stopped without realizing it and stared blankly at the sight.
hunks.sol: The Chinese Hunters stopped in their tracks without realizing it and stared blankly at the sight.

hunks.baseline: Sadly, it was all real.
hunks.sol: Unfortunately for them, it was all real.

hunks.baseline: A sphere of flame dozens of meters in diameter split into four pieces. Each of the four pieces split into dozens more, and those dozens became hundreds of fragments.
hunks.sol: The sphere of flame, dozens of meters in diameter, split into four pieces. Each of those four divided into dozens more, and those dozens shattered into hundreds of fragments.

hunks.baseline: A rain of fire slammed into the ground.
hunks.sol: Then the rain of fire struck the earth.

hunks.baseline: The surroundings were dyed red by the deafening explosions.
hunks.sol: The deafening explosions dyed everything red.

hunks.baseline: The drone was thrown off balance by the aftershock. When it finally steadied itself, the being responsible for creating that spectacular scene was staring directly at it.
hunks.sol: The blast knocked the drone off balance. By the time it finally steadied itself, the being responsible for that horrific scene was staring directly at it.

hunks.baseline: The voice had no inflection or vitality.
hunks.sol: Its voice held neither inflection nor vitality.

hunks.baseline: The figure had pulled a robe marked with strange patterns low over his head. He extended one finger and pointed at the drone.
hunks.sol: The figure wore a robe covered in strange patterns, its hood pulled low. It extended one finger toward the drone.

hunks.baseline: “I shall kill you all and take everything. Anyone who sets foot on my territory will pay for it with their life.”
hunks.sol: “I shall kill you all and take everything. Those who set foot upon my territory will pay with their lives.”

hunks.baseline: The instant that finger, twisted like the root of an ancient tree, moved, the video cut out amid a burst of static.
hunks.sol: The instant that finger, gnarled like the root of an ancient tree, moved, the video vanished in a burst of static.

hunks.baseline: The gray sky filled with fine dust disappeared. So did the scene on the ground, one that deserved to be called the end of the world.
hunks.sol: The gray sky choked with fine dust disappeared. So did the scene below, a sight that could only be called the end of the world.

hunks.baseline: The hologram vanished, and a heavy silence descended over the office.
hunks.sol: With the hologram gone, a heavy silence descended over the office.

hunks.baseline: “He’s the man behind this Monster Wave. No—he isn’t a man, so I suppose that phrase isn’t quite right.”
hunks.sol: “He is the man responsible for this Monster Wave. No—he isn’t a man, so I suppose that isn’t quite the right word.”

hunks.baseline: “The Named Monster Lich. That is what he is.”
hunks.sol: “A Named Monster. A Lich. That is what he is.”

hunks.baseline: The Lich that had supposedly vanished after the Great Cataclysm had appeared. It had caused an enormous catastrophe, as though celebrating its return after several decades.
hunks.sol: The Liches that had supposedly vanished after the Great Cataclysm had returned—or at least one of them had, causing an enormous catastrophe as though celebrating its first appearance in decades.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi pulled out the USB drive and spoke.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi unplugged the USB drive and spoke.

hunks.baseline: “November fifth. This footage was taken exactly ten days ago by a reconnaissance drone belonging to Chinese intelligence. It shows a small city near Nanchong, Sichuan Province. The estimated casualties so far are approximately three hundred thousand. We still don’t have an accurate tally.”
hunks.sol: “November fifth. This footage was recorded exactly ten days ago by a reconnaissance drone belonging to Chinese intelligence. It shows a small city near Nanchong City in Sichuan Province. The estimated number of casualties so far is approximately three hundred thousand. An accurate count is still unavailable.”

hunks.baseline: Of course, the Murim was an entirely different world that merely resembled China, and what the hologram had shown us was a massive catastrophe.
hunks.sol: Of course, Murim was an entirely different world that merely resembled China, and what the hologram had shown us was a catastrophe on an unimaginable scale.

hunks.baseline: “And that is only the record from the first twenty-four hours after the Wave began.”
hunks.sol: “And that figure covers only the first twenty-four hours after the Wave began.”

hunks.baseline: The estimated casualties for a single day alone were three hundred thousand. Had humanity ever suffered this much damage from a Monster Wave since the Great Cataclysm?
hunks.sol: Three hundred thousand estimated casualties in a single day. Had humanity suffered this much damage from a Monster Wave even once since the Great Cataclysm?

hunks.baseline: I directed the question not at Team Leader Choi, but at Butler Kim—the only living witness among us who had experienced the Great Cataclysm firsthand.
hunks.sol: I directed the question not at Team Leader Choi but at Butler Kim, the only one among us who had lived through the Great Cataclysm.

hunks.baseline: His eyes trembled like ripples on water.
hunks.sol: His eyes were trembling.

hunks.baseline: “Could that possibly be the case? The Liches I saw with my own eyes during the Great Cataclysm were all powerful beings, certainly… but that one is on an entirely different level. Its fire magic was enough to give me goose bumps just watching it.”
hunks.sol: “Of course not. The Liches I saw with my own eyes during the Great Cataclysm were all immensely powerful, but… that one is on an entirely different level. Its fire magic gave me goose bumps just watching it.”

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim was an A-rank mage whose specialty was fire magic.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim was an A-rank mage who specialized in fire magic.

hunks.baseline: If someone who had experienced every kind of hardship during the Great Cataclysm spoke like that, it was easy to understand just how powerful the Lich that had appeared this time was.
hunks.sol: If a man who had been through hell and back during the Great Cataclysm said that, it showed just how powerful this Lich was.

hunks.baseline: The burning city and the people collapsing in pools of blood flickered before my eyes. The enormous rain of fire striking the earth had been a disaster in the truest sense of the word.
hunks.sol: The burning city and the people collapsing in pools of blood lingered before my eyes. The enormous rain of fire that had hammered the earth was a disaster in the truest sense of the word.

hunks.baseline: At the very end, I remembered the declaration the creature had made toward the camera.
hunks.sol: I remembered the declaration the creature had made to the camera at the very end.

hunks.baseline: *I shall kill you all and take everything. Anyone who sets foot on my territory will pay for it with their life.*
hunks.sol: *I shall kill you all and take everything. Those who set foot upon my territory will pay with their lives.*

hunks.baseline: Thanks to the Integrated Language Pack, part of the System, I had heard its words clearly and understood what they meant.
hunks.sol: Thanks to the Integrated Language Pack, part of the System, I had heard every word clearly and understood what they meant.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t particularly like China, but no sane person would see such a terrible disaster and laugh, saying that they had gotten what they deserved.
hunks.sol: I didn’t particularly like China, but no sane person could look at a catastrophe like this and laugh that they had gotten what they deserved.

hunks.baseline: A bitter taste filled my mouth as I thought of the people who had died helplessly and the little girl crying after losing her mother. That was when a thought suddenly occurred to me.
hunks.sol: The thought of all those people dying helplessly—and the little girl crying over her dead mother—left a bitter taste in my mouth.
Then something occurred to me.

hunks.baseline: As I recovered somewhat from the shock, something strange struck me.
hunks.sol: Now that I had recovered somewhat from the shock, one thing struck me as strange.

hunks.baseline: It had been ten days since a catastrophe of this magnitude had occurred, yet the world was peaceful.
hunks.sol: A catastrophe of this magnitude had happened ten days ago, yet the world remained peaceful.

hunks.baseline: *Where had Team Leader Choi gotten this information?*
hunks.sol: *Where did Team Leader Choi get this information?*
